title: Span-Enrichment Sidecar: context-aware sampling, logs-to-metrics bridge, and burst-resistant alert throttling
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We see noisy burn-rate alerts caused by uneven trace sampling and missing request-context metadata. Current alerting inflates oncall load during microbursts because traces lack tenant-aware KV-cache markers and correlated logs are not consistently bridged to short-window metrics. Goal: deliver a lightweight span-enrichment sidecar that attaches sampling-weight and cache-context to spans, emits compact logs-to-metrics markers, and exposes a small realtime metrics stream used by burn-rate calculators and pager-throttlers to reduce false positives during short bursts.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar injects sampling_weight and kv_cache_hit boolean into outgoing spans for all instrumented services (configurable per-service).
Logs-to-metrics bridge produces a 1s-bucket metric 'svc.request.kv_cache_hit_rate' and 'svc.request.sampling_adjusted_latency' consumable by SLO pipeline.
Burn-rate adapter consumes the metrics stream and reduces paging for bursts < 30s unless error fraction also exceeds threshold.
E2E load test demonstrates 40-60% reduction in paging events for controlled microburst scenarios without losing true-positive alerts.
Documentation and rollout runbook published in Confluence and Console feature flagging added for safe canary.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket. Spike confirmed that adding a sampling_weight field and kv_cache_hit tag to spans is feasible with our current OpenTelemetry pipeline. Initial design doc linked.

2026-02-28 - Jonah Miller: Completed a minimal sidecar PoC that attaches sampling_weight (float) and kv_cache_key (hashed) to spans. Early memory overhead is ~1.8MB/resident per sidecar when run in dev harness.

2026-03-03 - Priya Desai (observability): Ran end-to-end trace + logs ingestion with PoC sidecar on staging. Observed missing log correlation for legacy services; added suggestion to ship a tiny log forwarder in sidecar for those cases.

2026-03-05 - Jonah Miller: Implemented the logs-to-metrics bridge producing 'svc.request.kv_cache_hit_rate' at 1s resolution and 'svc.request.sampling_adjusted_latency' computed as latency/sampling_weight. Instrumented burn-rate adapter to ingest these metrics over Kafka topic 'obs.short-window-metrics'.

2026-03-07 - QA: Began synthetic microburst tests. Initial runs show desired reduction in pages but a small latency increase under heavy cache-miss storms; investigating whether sidecar batching or backpressure is causing ephemeral queueing.

2026-03-09 - Design review: Agreed to make kv_cache_key hashed and not include raw keys to avoid PII. Security reviewed the design; no KMS changes required. Added flag to redact additional fields for Private deployments.

2026-03-11 - Jonah Miller: Tuned sidecar batching heuristics; reduced resident memory by ~12% and lowered request queueing. Updated prototype PR with perf numbers and added unit tests for metric generation logic.

2026-03-12 - Aisha Patel: Decided rollout strategy: enable sidecar on 10% of services in staging -> run 48h microburst/chaos tests -> increase to 30% with burn-rate adapter enabled -> staggered prod canary per region with oncall notification changes. Added dependency on runtime-1.20 release window.
next_steps: Complete integration tests for legacy log-forwarding path (owner: Jonah).
Add optional per-tenant sampling override config to reduce weighting noise for large customers (owner: Priya).
Wire burn-rate adapter outputs into Console SLO pipeline and add visualizations (owner: Observability UX).
Publish rollout runbook and schedule 48h staging run (owner: Aisha).
